correctness.rationale: All seven occupancy partitions are enumerated. Three-wise independence fixes E[T2]=10/q and E[T3]=10/q^2. The pointwise certificates T2/2-T3 <= I and I <= T2-(9/10)T3 give the universal bounds. Explicit occupancy mixtures attain each endpoint, and symmetry plus the two collision moments proves uniformity of every ordered triple. An exact-rational checker independently replays the identities and explicit small-q joint laws.

The published pairwise occupancy result has a one-moment reduction and cannot imply the additional triple-collision constraint used here.

value.rationale: The theorem exactly quantifies the birthday-event uncertainty left by three-wise independence at five keys, a set size explicitly singled out in classical three-independent hashing analysis. It supplies both endpoint constructions, a sharp q=9 lower-threshold, and the entire attainable interval. This is a structural finite classification rather than a routine numerical extension.
